fixed_script = '''from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF

UNICODE_REPLACEMENTS = {
    "\\u2014": "-",
    "\\u2013": "-",
    "\\u2018": "'",
    "\\u2019": "'",
    "\\u201c": '"',
    "\\u201d": '"',
    "\\u2026": "...",
    "\\u00a0": " ",
    "\\u2022": "*",
    "\\u00b7": "*",
    "\\u2010": "-",
    "\\u2011": "-",
    "\\u2012": "-",
    "\\u00ad": "-",
}

def sanitize(text):
    for uc, repl in UNICODE_REPLACEMENTS.items():
        text = text.replace(uc, repl)
    return text.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1")

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        pdf.ln(4)
        continue

    safe = sanitize(text)
    style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""

    if "Title" in style_name or "Heading 1" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 16)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, safe)
        pdf.ln(4)
    elif "Heading 2" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 13)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, safe)
        pdf.ln(3)
    elif "Heading" in style_name:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, safe)
        pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, safe)
        pdf.ln(1)

pdf.output("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
print("PDF created successfully")
'''
